pinyin: zì zuò niè, bù kě huó
literal: self · make · evil, not · can · live
natural: you cannot escape the trouble you make yourself

meaning.en: Disasters brought on by one's own wrongdoing cannot be escaped.
meaning.zh: 自己做了坏事招来的灾祸，无法逃脱。

equivalents: you've made your bed, now lie in it
as you sow, so shall you reap

examples.zh: 他赌博成瘾，输光家产，真是自作孽，不可活。
examples.en: He was addicted to gambling and lost everything: he brought it on himself.

examples.zh: 公司造假被查，老板自作孽，不可活。
examples.en: The firm was caught faking its figures; the boss has only himself to blame.

story.en: Mencius quotes the 'Taijia' chapter: 'Calamities sent by Heaven can be avoided; calamities one makes oneself cannot be escaped.'
story.zh: 《孟子》引《太甲》：“天作孽，犹可违；自作孽，不可活。”

usage.en: Usually a verdict on someone else's downfall, often with little sympathy; sounds slightly stern.
usage.zh: 多用来评说他人咎由自取的下场，语气较严厉。

pinyin: bān qǐ shí tou zá zì jǐ de jiǎo
literal: lift up · stone · smash · one's own · foot
natural: to drop the rock on your own foot

meaning.en: To harm oneself with a scheme meant to harm someone else.
meaning.zh: 本想害别人，结果害了自己。

equivalents: to shoot oneself in the foot
to be hoist with one's own petard

examples.zh: 他造谣中伤同事，结果搬起石头砸自己的脚，丢了工作。
examples.en: He spread rumours about a colleague and it backfired: he lost his own job.

examples.zh: 你这样耍小聪明，小心搬起石头砸自己的脚。
examples.en: Be careful with these tricks, or you'll shoot yourself in the foot.

usage.en: Often used as a warning; the full form sometimes continues 举起石头砸自己的脚.
usage.zh: 常作警告；也说“搬石头砸自己的脚”。

text: 凡事留一线，日后好相见
pinyin: fán shì liú yī xiàn, rì hòu hǎo xiāng jiàn
literal: every · matter · leave · one · thread, later · can · meet
natural: leave a thread of room, so you can meet again later

meaning.en: Do not push things to the extreme; leave room for others so you can still face each other later.
meaning.zh: 做事不要做绝，留有余地，以后还能好好相处。

equivalents: don't burn your bridges
leave a way out

examples.zh: 他再生气也没撕破脸，凡事留一线，日后好相见。
examples.en: However angry he was, he didn't tear things up: leave some room for later.

examples.zh: 谈判时别把话说死，凡事留一线，日后好相见。
examples.en: Don't say things too finally in negotiations; you may need to meet again.

usage.en: Advice on dealing with people; often paired with 得饶人处且饶人.
usage.zh: 劝人处事留有余地，常与“得饶人处且饶人”连用。

pinyin: huà dào zuǐ biān liú bàn jù
literal: words · reach · mouth · edge · keep · half · sentence
natural: hold back half of what is on the tip of your tongue

meaning.en: Be discreet; do not say everything that comes to mind.
meaning.zh: 说话要谨慎，不要把想到的话全说出来。

equivalents: think before you speak
least said, soonest mended

examples.zh: 话到嘴边留半句，在领导面前不要什么都说。
examples.en: Hold something back; don't tell your boss everything.

examples.zh: 老人常教导我们话到嘴边留半句，免得得罪人。
examples.en: Elders tell us to hold our tongue to avoid offending people.

usage.en: Advice about tact; the variant 留三分 is also common.
usage.zh: 劝人说话留有余地；也说“话到嘴边留三分”。

text: 见人说人话，见鬼说鬼话
pinyin: jiàn rén shuō rén huà, jiàn guǐ shuō guǐ huà
literal: meet · person · speak · human · words, meet · ghost · speak · ghost · words
natural: speak human to humans and ghost to ghosts

meaning.en: To tell each listener whatever suits them; to be two-faced and insincere.
meaning.zh: 对不同的人说不同的话，圆滑虚伪。

equivalents: to tell everyone what they want to hear
to speak with a forked tongue

examples.zh: 他见人说人话，见鬼说鬼话，没人信他。
examples.en: He tells everyone what they want to hear; nobody trusts him.

examples.zh: 做销售不能见人说人话，见鬼说鬼话。
examples.en: In sales you can't just say whatever suits each customer.

usage.en: Derogatory; sometimes used with grudging admiration for social skill.
usage.zh: 多含贬义，有时也带点佩服其圆滑。

pinyin: jiàn guài bù guài, qí guài zì bài
literal: see · strange · not · find strange, its · strangeness · by itself · fails
natural: treat the strange as ordinary and it defeats itself

meaning.en: If you stay calm about strange things, they lose their power to harm or frighten.
meaning.zh: 遇到怪事不惊慌、不理会，怪事自然会消失。

equivalents: don't pay it any mind and it will go away
stay calm in the face of the strange

examples.zh: 见怪不怪，其怪自败，别被那些谣言吓住。
examples.en: Keep calm and the weirdness fades; don't be scared by those rumours.

examples.zh: 半夜听到怪声，他想起见怪不怪，其怪自败，翻身又睡了。
examples.en: Hearing odd noises at night, he remembered the saying and went back to sleep.

usage.en: Often just the first half is quoted: 见怪不怪.
usage.zh: 常只说前半句“见怪不怪”。

pinyin: tīng rén quàn, chī bǎo fàn
literal: listen · people · advise, eat · full · meal
natural: heed advice and you'll eat your fill

meaning.en: Listening to good advice keeps you out of trouble and leads to a good outcome.
meaning.zh: 肯听别人的劝告，就不会吃亏，日子过得好。

equivalents: take advice and you'll be better off
it pays to listen

examples.zh: 听人劝，吃饱饭，你就按医生说的做吧。
examples.en: It pays to listen: just do what the doctor says.

examples.zh: 他不听人劝，最后亏了不少钱，真是听人劝，吃饱饭啊。
examples.en: He wouldn't listen and lost a lot; heed advice and you'll do well.

usage.en: Used to urge someone to accept advice.
usage.zh: 用来劝人接受别人的意见。

text: 听君一席话，胜读十年书
pinyin: tīng jūn yī xí huà, shèng dú shí nián shū
literal: hear · you · one · mat · talk, beat · read · ten · years · books
natural: an evening of your talk beats ten years of reading

meaning.en: A conversation with a wise person can teach more than years of study (also a compliment).
meaning.zh: 听了你的一番话，收获比读十年书还大。

equivalents: a talk with you is worth ten years of study
I learnt more from you tonight than from books

examples.zh: 今天和您聊了一下午，听君一席话，胜读十年书。
examples.en: After an afternoon with you, I've learnt more than from years of books.

examples.zh: 听君一席话，胜读十年书，谢谢老师指点。
examples.en: Thank you, teacher; your advice has taught me a great deal.

usage.en: Mostly a polite compliment to the speaker; may be slightly humorous.
usage.zh: 多作客气的恭维话，有时带玩笑。

pinyin: tīng huà tīng yīn, luó gǔ tīng shēng
literal: listen · words · listen · tone, gong · drum · listen · sound
natural: hear the tone in the words, as you hear the beat of the drum

meaning.en: Listen for the real meaning behind what people say.
meaning.zh: 听别人说话要听出话里隐含的意思。

equivalents: read between the lines
listen to what is meant, not what is said

examples.zh: 听话听音，锣鼓听声，他那句话明显是在暗示你。
examples.en: Read between the lines: that remark was clearly a hint to you.

examples.zh: 做秘书要懂得听话听音，锣鼓听声。
examples.en: A secretary has to grasp what lies behind people's words.

usage.en: Advice about reading hints; the variant swaps 音 and 声.
usage.zh: 劝人领会弦外之音；也说“听话听声，锣鼓听音”。

text: 书中自有黄金屋，书中自有颜如玉
pinyin: shū zhōng zì yǒu huáng jīn wū, shū zhōng zì yǒu yán rú yù
literal: book · in · naturally · has · golden · house, book · in · naturally · has · face · like · jade
natural: in books lie golden houses and jade-faced beauties

meaning.en: Study brings wealth and a good life; a classic encouragement to read.
meaning.zh: 读书能带来财富和美好的生活，用来劝人勤奋读书。

equivalents: knowledge is the road to riches
books are the ladder to success

examples.zh: 书中自有黄金屋，书中自有颜如玉，好好读书吧。
examples.en: Books hold gold and beauty; study hard.

examples.zh: 古人说书中自有黄金屋，书中自有颜如玉，其实是鼓励读书。
examples.en: The old saying about golden houses in books really just urges people to read.

usage.en: Traditional exhortation; today often quoted half-jokingly.
usage.zh: 传统劝学语，今天常半开玩笑地引用。

synonyms: 万般皆下品，唯有读书高

text: 书山有路勤为径，学海无涯苦作舟
pinyin: shū shān yǒu lù qín wéi jìng, xué hǎi wú yá kǔ zuò zhōu
literal: book · mountain · has · path · diligence · is · trail, learning · sea · no · shore · hard work · is · boat
natural: diligence is the path up the mountain of books, hard work the boat on the sea of learning

meaning.en: Only diligence and hard work will carry you through the vast world of knowledge.
meaning.zh: 在知识的海洋里，只有勤奋刻苦才能前进。

equivalents: there is no royal road to learning
no pain, no gain

examples.zh: 书山有路勤为径，学海无涯苦作舟，同学们要努力。
examples.en: Diligence is the path and hard work the boat; students, work hard.

examples.zh: 他把书山有路勤为径，学海无涯苦作舟写在书桌前。
examples.en: He wrote this couplet about diligence above his desk.

usage.en: A couplet often quoted in school and graduation speeches.
usage.zh: 常用于学校、毕业赠言和作文。

text: 学如逆水行舟，不进则退
pinyin: xué rú nì shuǐ xíng zhōu, bù jìn zé tuì
literal: study · like · against · water · sail · boat, not · advance · then · retreat
natural: studying is like rowing upstream: stop advancing and you drift back

meaning.en: Learning must never pause; if you stop making progress you fall behind.
meaning.zh: 学习像逆流划船，不努力前进就会后退。

equivalents: if you're not moving forward, you're falling behind
use it or lose it

examples.zh: 学如逆水行舟，不进则退，暑假也不能放松。
examples.en: Learning is like rowing upstream: don't relax even in the summer holidays.

examples.zh: 老师常说学如逆水行舟，不进则退。
examples.en: The teacher often says that if you stop advancing you fall back.

usage.en: The shorter form 逆水行舟，不进则退 is also used for business and competition.
usage.zh: 简称“逆水行舟，不进则退”，也可用于事业、竞争。

text: 万般皆下品，唯有读书高
pinyin: wàn bān jiē xià pǐn, wéi yǒu dú shū gāo
literal: all · kinds · all · low · grade, only · have · read · books · high
natural: every trade is lowly; only scholarship is lofty

meaning.en: The traditional view that scholarship is the highest calling, above every other occupation.
meaning.zh: 旧时认为只有读书做官才是最高尚的出路。

equivalents: learning is the highest pursuit

examples.zh: 万般皆下品，唯有读书高，这种旧观念已经过时了。
examples.en: 'Only scholarship is lofty': that old idea is out of date.

examples.zh: 爷爷从小灌输万般皆下品，唯有读书高的想法。
examples.en: Grandpa drilled into us that only studying counts.

usage.en: Now usually quoted critically, as an outdated attitude.
usage.zh: 今天多带批评地引用，指过时观念。

pinyin: tōu jī bù zháo shí bǎ mǐ
literal: steal · chicken · fail to get · lose · handful · rice
natural: fail to steal the chicken and lose the rice used as bait

meaning.en: To try to gain something improperly and end up losing what you already had.
meaning.zh: 想占便宜反而吃了亏。

equivalents: to go for wool and come home shorn
to lose one's shirt trying to make a fast buck

examples.zh: 他想骗保险，结果偷鸡不着蚀把米，还赔了一笔钱。
examples.en: He tried to cheat the insurer and ended up paying out himself.

examples.zh: 别贪小便宜，小心偷鸡不着蚀把米。
examples.en: Don't be greedy for small gains, or you'll lose what you have.

usage.en: Describes a would-be schemer who loses out.
usage.zh: 多指想占便宜反吃亏的人。

pinyin: yī zhāo tiān zǐ yī zhāo chén
literal: one · reign · emperor · one · reign · ministers
natural: a new emperor brings a new set of ministers

meaning.en: A new leader brings in his own people and replaces the old staff.
meaning.zh: 换了新领导，就会换上新的班子。

equivalents: new broom sweeps clean
a new boss brings a new team

examples.zh: 新总经理一来就调整班子，真是一朝天子一朝臣。
examples.en: The new GM reshuffled the team at once: new boss, new team.

examples.zh: 一朝天子一朝臣，老员工们都有点担心。
examples.en: With a new emperor come new ministers; the veterans are nervous.

usage.en: Often said about office politics after a leadership change.
usage.zh: 多用于领导更替后的人事变动。

text: 以其人之道，还治其人之身
pinyin: yǐ qí rén zhī dào, huán zhì qí rén zhī shēn
literal: with · his · person's · way, return · treat · his · person's · body
natural: use his own methods against him

meaning.en: To pay someone back with the very methods they used on others.
meaning.zh: 用对方的办法来对付对方。

equivalents: to give someone a taste of their own medicine
to beat someone at their own game

examples.zh: 他们造谣，我们就公布真相，以其人之道，还治其人之身。
examples.en: They spread lies; we publish the facts and turn their methods against them.

examples.zh: 对手总是挖我们的人，我们也以其人之道，还治其人之身。
examples.en: The rival keeps poaching our staff, so we will do the same to them.

usage.en: Often used of retaliation in business or politics.
usage.zh: 多用于商业、政治上的反击。

pinyin: lǎo zi yīng xióng ér hǎo hàn
variants: 老子英雄儿好汉，老子反动儿混蛋
literal: father · hero · son · fine · fellow
natural: if the father is a hero, the son is a good man

meaning.en: A heroic father raises a capable son (also used ironically of the opposite).
meaning.zh: 父亲有本事，儿子也有出息。

equivalents: like father, like son
a chip off the old block

examples.zh: 老子英雄儿好汉，他们父子都是冠军。
examples.en: Like father, like son: both of them are champions.

examples.zh: 人们常说老子英雄儿好汉，其实孩子也要自己努力。
examples.en: People say the son of a hero is a hero, but kids must work too.

usage.en: Sometimes extended ironically with 老子反动儿混蛋 (a bad father, a bad son).
usage.zh: 有时后接“老子反动儿混蛋”，指父子皆不好。

pinyin: dāng miàn luó, duì miàn gǔ
literal: face to face · gong, opposite · drum
natural: gong facing gong, drum facing drum

meaning.en: To settle matters openly, face to face.
meaning.zh: 当着面把话说清楚，不背后搞小动作。

equivalents: let's have it out face to face
to speak plainly to someone's face

examples.zh: 有意见就当面锣，对面鼓地说清楚。
examples.en: If you have a complaint, say it to my face.

examples.zh: 两家人当面锣，对面鼓，把误会说开了。
examples.en: The two families talked it through face to face and cleared up the misunderstanding.

usage.en: Often used as 当面锣，对面鼓地…; the tone is blunt but fair.
usage.zh: 常说“当面锣，对面鼓地……”，语气直率。

text: 人活一张脸，树活一张皮
pinyin: rén huó yī zhāng liǎn, shù huó yī zhāng pí
literal: person · lives · one · face, tree · lives · one · bark
natural: a person lives by his face as a tree lives by its bark

meaning.en: Self-respect and reputation are as vital to a person as bark is to a tree.
meaning.zh: 人要靠脸面（尊严）生活，就像树靠树皮生存。

equivalents: a man's honour is his life
losing face is like peeling a tree

examples.zh: 人活一张脸，树活一张皮，做事不能不要脸面。
examples.en: A person needs face as a tree needs bark; don't act shamelessly.

examples.zh: 他说人活一张脸，树活一张皮，死也不肯低头认输。
examples.en: He said a man lives by his face and would not bow even if it killed him.

usage.en: Used both to urge dignity and to excuse stubborn pride.
usage.zh: 既用来劝人要自尊，也用来解释好面子。

pinyin: zhǐ jiàn shù mù, bù jiàn sēn lín
literal: only · see · trees, not · see · forest
natural: see the trees but not the forest

meaning.en: To focus on details and lose sight of the big picture.
meaning.zh: 只看到局部细节，看不到整体。

equivalents: can't see the forest for the trees

examples.zh: 做规划时不能只见树木，不见森林。
examples.en: In planning you can't see only the trees and miss the forest.

examples.zh: 他太纠结小细节，只见树木，不见森林。
examples.en: He gets bogged down in details and misses the big picture.

usage.en: A calque of the English 'can't see the forest for the trees'.
usage.zh: 与英语 can't see the forest for the trees 意思相同。

pinyin: gān dǎ léi, bù xià yǔ
literal: dry · thunder, not · fall · rain
natural: all thunder and no rain

meaning.en: Plenty of noise but no real action or result.
meaning.zh: 声势大，却没有实际行动或结果。

equivalents: all talk and no action
all bark and no bite

examples.zh: 他嚷嚷着要辞职，其实是干打雷，不下雨。
examples.en: He keeps shouting that he'll quit, but it's all thunder and no rain.

examples.zh: 这个项目喊了三年，还是干打雷，不下雨。
examples.en: The project has been announced for three years and nothing has come of it.

usage.en: Often used of empty threats or promises.
usage.zh: 多用于空洞的威胁或承诺。

pinyin: dāo zi zuǐ, dòu fu xīn
literal: knife · mouth, tofu · heart
natural: a knife of a mouth but a heart of tofu

meaning.en: Sharp-tongued but kind-hearted.
meaning.zh: 说话尖刻，心地善良。

equivalents: her bark is worse than her bite
a heart of gold under a rough tongue

examples.zh: 妈妈刀子嘴，豆腐心，骂完还是给我做好吃的。
examples.en: Mum has a sharp tongue and a soft heart; after scolding me she cooks something nice.

examples.zh: 别介意，他就是刀子嘴，豆腐心。
examples.en: Don't mind him: he's sharp-tongued but kind.

usage.en: Affectionate; usually said of elders, friends and colleagues.
usage.zh: 带亲昵意味，多说长辈、朋友、同事。

pinyin: yī yè zhàng mù, bù jiàn tài shān
literal: one · leaf · block · eye, not · see · Mount Tai
natural: a single leaf over the eye hides Mount Tai

meaning.en: To be blinded by a minor matter and miss the larger truth.
meaning.zh: 被眼前的小事蒙蔽，看不到重大的事物。

equivalents: can't see the wood for the trees
to be blind to the big picture

examples.zh: 别被小利迷住，一叶障目，不见泰山。
examples.en: Don't be dazzled by small gains and miss the big picture.

examples.zh: 他只盯着眼前的数据，一叶障目，不见泰山。
examples.en: He stared at the numbers in front of him and missed the larger picture.

story.en: The Warring States text Heguanzi says that one leaf over the eyes keeps even Mount Tai from view.
story.zh: 《鹖冠子》有“一叶蔽目，不见泰山”之语。

usage.en: The four-character form 一叶障目 is more common alone.
usage.zh: 单说“一叶障目”也很常见。

pinyin: dà mén bù chū, èr mén bù mài
literal: main · gate · not · go out, inner · gate · not · step over
natural: never going out the main gate, nor even over the inner one

meaning.en: To stay at home and never go out.
meaning.zh: 整天待在家里，从不外出。

equivalents: to stay shut indoors
to be a homebody

examples.zh: 他放假时大门不出，二门不迈，天天宅在家里。
examples.en: On holiday he never leaves the house, staying in every day.

examples.zh: 她以前大门不出，二门不迈，现在爱上了旅行。
examples.en: She used to stay home all the time, but now loves travelling.

usage.en: Originally said of sheltered women in old households; now used humorously for homebodies.
usage.zh: 原指旧时深闺女子，今多用来幽默地形容宅在家里。

pinyin: huáng tiān bù fù kǔ xīn rén
literal: august · heaven · not · fail · painstaking · person
natural: Heaven does not fail those who take pains

meaning.en: Diligent and determined people will eventually be rewarded.
meaning.zh: 只要下苦功、有恒心，终究会有回报。

equivalents: hard work pays off
perseverance will be rewarded

examples.zh: 皇天不负苦心人，他终于考上了理想的大学。
examples.en: Heaven rewards the earnest: he finally got into his dream university.

examples.zh: 练了十年，皇天不负苦心人，她拿到了金牌。
examples.en: After ten years of training, her effort paid off with a gold medal.

usage.en: Often used to congratulate or encourage; also 功夫不负有心人.
usage.zh: 用于祝贺或鼓励；近似“功夫不负有心人”。
